source: Saved three-scope browser evaluation, compacted for deterministic grouping review

cases.reason: Both options sell the same cohort operator an unresolved-learner queue that collects questions or blockers, tracks human follow-up, and keeps each case open until the learner or instructor confirms resolution.

candidate.buyer: Independent instructors running paid technical cohorts
candidate.buyingTrigger: Learner questions remain unanswered across live sessions or support channels
candidate.jobToBeDone: Keep each learner question visible until a human reviews its resolution
candidate.coreWorkflow: Capture a lesson-linked question, group related blockers, send a reviewed response, and track per-learner resolution
candidate.currentSubstitute: Chat or email plus a spreadsheet, task board, or helpdesk

target.buyer: Small paid cohort operators teaching live coding sessions
target.buyingTrigger: Simultaneous learner questions make it hard to track who recovered
target.jobToBeDone: Keep learner blockers visible until recovery is confirmed
target.coreWorkflow: Collect blocker reports, share a workaround, and confirm which learners remain blocked
target.currentSubstitute: Chat, raised hands, polls, forms, or a shared issue list

cases.reason: The validator is bought before publishing an exercise to reconcile code and instructions. The support inbox is bought during a cohort to resolve learner questions. Their triggers, jobs, workflows, and standalone value require separate purchases.

candidate.buyer: Independent educators who repeatedly revise repository-based JavaScript exercises
candidate.buyingTrigger: An exercise revision is about to be released to a paying cohort
candidate.jobToBeDone: Find contradictions among starter files, solutions, examples, checks, dependencies, and instructions before publication
candidate.coreWorkflow: Run a local prepublication check and review a reproducible contradiction report
candidate.currentSubstitute: CI, repository tests, manual dry-runs, and LMS preview

target.buyer: Independent instructors running paid technical cohorts
target.buyingTrigger: Learner questions remain unanswered across live sessions or support channels
target.jobToBeDone: Keep each learner question visible until a human reviews its resolution
target.coreWorkflow: Capture, answer, and track each learner question through resolution
target.currentSubstitute: Chat or email plus a manually maintained queue
